concerns.text: The primary validation metric (Parameter Coverage Score) is computed by checking whether parameter names appear in the generated docstring, yet the generation prompt *solely* consists of the method signature (which already contains those parameter names). This makes the metric circular: the predictor (LLM output) is given the exact information the metric evaluates, so high coverage can be achieved trivially by copying the signature. The plan acknowledges this limitation (FR‑013) but still uses the metric as the main evidence of documentation completeness, violating the independence requirement for a sound scientific validation.
